Aye Dard Ke Darman Sultan-e-Khurasan.
Aala Hai Teri Shan Quran Ke Quran.
Hum Sab Ka Hai Eman Janat Hai Khurasan.
Kiya Jo Zikar Ali Ka Raza Ke Rozay Par.
Najaf Ka Dekha Nazara Raza Ke Rozay Par.
Qabool Ho Gayi Toba Raza Ke Rozay Par.
Parha Jo Sorah-e-Toba Raza Ke Rozay Par.
Rasool Turk Ko Dekha Raza Ke Rozay Par.
Khushi Mein Jhoom Raha Tha Raza Ke Rozay Par.
Ghareeb Ho Nahi Ja Saktay Hajj Pe Aao Chalo.
Sawab Hajj Ka Miley Ga Raza Ke Rozay Par.
Khuda Ka Shukar Ke Dharkan Ka Our Nobat Ka.
Tha Rang Aik Hi Jaisa Raza Ke Rozay Par.
Samajh Mein Aa Gayi Khud Rah-e-Mustaqeem Mujhe.
Parha Jo Hamd Ka Sorah Raza Ke Rozay Par.
Yahan Pe Koi Gunahgar Aa Nahi Sakta.
Kahin Likha Nahi Dekha Raza Ke Rozay Par.
Muzeef Shah-e-Khurasan Mein Khuli Mujh Par.
Haqeeqat-e-Man-o-Salwa Raza Ke Rozay Par.
Meri Beyaz Mein Khamosh Tha Jo Arsay Se.
Woh Shair Ho Gaya Zindah Raza Ke Rozay Par.
Ali Ali Ki Sada De Raha Tha Jab Main Ne.
Kalam-e-Pak Ko Khola Raza Ke Rozay Par.
Mila Youn Rizq Ke Jaisa Qatar Onton Ki.
Sawal-e-Rizq Kiya Tha Raza Ke Rozay Par.
Barhi Hoi Yeh Batati Hai Lau Charagon Ki.
Hawa Ka Bas Nahi Chalta Raza Ke Rozay Par.
Talash:MIR HASAN: Ko Na Karna Bad-e-Qaza.
Woh Karbala Mein Ya Ho Ga Raza Ke Rozay Par.

item.text:
Reconstructed all 29 verses in Urdu script and retained the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions align line by line and preserve the existing stanza and the میر حسن takhallus.

Set the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, retained the Roman alternate title, and removed the `noUrdu` tag. I read “Muzeef” as مضیف and “Shair” as شعر in context.
